I have updated `src/invoice.py` to calculate tax using standard "round half up" rounding to the cent in accordance with finance policy FIN-12:

```python
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP


def tax(amount, rate):
    """Tax on an invoice amount, to the cent."""
    d_amount = Decimal(str(amount))
    d_rate = Decimal(str(rate))
    tax_amount = d_amount * d_rate
    return float(tax_amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
```

This resolves the issue where $112.50 \times 0.09 = 10.125$ was being truncated down to $10.12$ instead of rounding half up to $10.13$.
